entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 100 to 150 mm of rain. Peak rates of 20 to 30 mm/h expected Monday evening. Note, another burst of heavy rain is possible Tuesday afternoon and evening. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal.

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 40 to 60 mm of rain about the main divide, and 20 to 30 mm within 20 km farther east, in addition to what has already fallen. Peak rates of 20 to 30 mm/h expected about the divide. Freezing level about 3200 metres. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal. Changes: Heavy rain has eased south of the Rakaia River and the Warning there is now lifted.

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 40 to 60 mm of rain about the ranges, and 10 to 20 mm nearer the coast, in addition to what has already fallen. Peak rates of 20 to 30 mm/h about the ranges. Freezing level about 3200 metres. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal. Changes: Heavy rain about and south of Harihari has eased and the Warning there has now been lifted.

entry.title: Strong Wind Watch
entry.summary: Northwest winds may approach severe gale in exposed places. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Low. Changes: The chance of upgrade for this Watch has been decreased to Low. Also, winds have eased south of Mt Hutt and the Watch there has been lifted.
